hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.
Restraints and whip checks on iron; exclusion zone around pressurized lines.

name: Header outlet (to the treating line)
function: The flanged outlet at the front of the discharge header where the single treating line to the zipper connects.

tabs.overview: One large-bore line to the zipper inlet isolation valve replaces the several small lines of older layouts; a second outlet or a split feeds a second manifold in simultaneous schemes.
tabs.engineering: Flanged or hammer union at the tree rating.
tabs.safety: Restrained line; the zipper inlet isolation valve is the isolation point on the other end.
tabs.evidence: Frac manifold missile patent (S31), electric fleet article (S37), fracturing design evolution article (S36), EIA regions (S38), field practice (S9). Photographs read for proportion only.
